By homeschooling, you can provide a more personalized and flexible learning environment that allows your children to learn at their own pace, explore topics in-depth, and develop a love for learning that can last a lifetime. So, to answer your question, I think it's absolutely right that you're homeschooling your kids to help them get smarter!
